title: Apache Log4j Remote Code Execution (Log4Shell)
description: JNDI lookup features do not protect against attacker-controlled LDAP and other JNDI related endpoints.
remediation: Upgrade log4j-core to 2.17.1 or higher, set log4j2.formatMsgNoLookups=true, or remove JndiLookup class.

title: OpenSSH Privilege Separation Vulnerability
description: Flaw in OpenSSH pre-authentication process allowing potential bypass under specific conditions.
remediation: Update OpenSSH to the latest package version and enforce strict key-based authentication.

title: XZ Utils Backdoor
description: Malicious code discovered in upstream tarballs of xz utils leading to unauthorized authentication bypass via sshd.
remediation: Immediately downgrade or upgrade to clean xz version (e.g. 5.6.1-patch or 5.4.6).

title: Spring Framework RCE (Spring4Shell)
description: Remote code execution in Spring Framework via DataBinder parameter binding under Tomcat deployment.
remediation: Upgrade Spring Framework to 5.3.18 / 5.2.20 or Spring Boot 2.6.6 / 2.5.12.

title: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset Denial of Service
description: HTTP/2 protocol allows stream cancellation abuse resulting in severe server resource exhaustion.
remediation: Apply HTTP/2 rapid-reset mitigations or limit RST_STREAM frame rates per connection.

title: Windows Print Spooler RCE (PrintNightmare)
description: Improper privilege management in Windows Print Spooler service allows remote code execution.
remediation: Disable Print Spooler service on non-essential systems or apply Microsoft security updates.
